integration_decision.name: NO_NEW_SOURCE_ONLY_ORACLE_REVISION_EXECUTION_GATE
integration_decision.finding: Re-read exact-SHA runner, handoff, storage and atomic test. run_once exposes archive_records_loaded/scoring_records_loaded and separately publishes latest/audit/anata JSON after releasing archive lock. Existing atomic test checks replacement completeness, not same-T cross-writer ordering. Frozen causal-retention oracle is sufficient as a test contract; suspected stale publication remains UNREPRODUCED. Executor success on worker-control SHA is valid bounded done-task evidence for public commit, not an independent exact-public-SHA CI check.
integration_decision.frozen_no_network_contract: At exact public SHA with approved spawn-safe test-only overlay, fixed T: writer A loads 0 archived rows and pauses before anata_latest publication; writer B appends rowB, loads 1 archived and 1 scoring row, finishes while A is paused; assert B nested source_evidence[*].clock_provenance.effective.source_record_id=rowB; resume A and assert final persisted anata_latest retains B; reverse-order control; bounded waits/child exit codes; overlay SHA256, stdout/stderr and non-skipped counts.
